name: Hingham Maritime Center
description_short: Youth summer programs on Hingham Harbor run by the Hingham Maritime Center: Little Mariners marine-science weeks for ages 5–7, sailing for ages 7 and up (Beginner, Intermediate, Venture, Opti Race, 420), and rowing for grades 7–12. Sessions run one to four weeks, led by experienced instructors with safety launches.
activities: Marine science and beach exploration (Little Mariners)
